newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-TSZYU RETAINS IBF JUNIOR WELTERWEIGHT TITLE AGAINST MAS.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-TSZYU RETAINS IBF JUNIOR WELTERWEIGHT TITLE AGAINST MAS.

text.p: Konstantin Tszyu of Russia retained his International Boxing Federation junior welterweight title Saturday by technical draw after committing an accidental foul against Puerto Rican Leonardo Mas.

In the final seconds of the opening round, Tszyu, who had knocked the challenger down twice, hit Mas as referee Joe Cortez was stepping in to break up the fighters. The punch was ruled unintentional but broke the jaw of Mas, who could not continue.
